verify.banner: Confirm your email ({email}) to connect a WhatsApp number. Check your inbox for the link.
verify.sent: We sent a new link to {email}.
verify.doneBody: Thanks. You can now connect your WhatsApp number.

errors.network: We can't reach Trik. Check your connection and try again.
errors.server-error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a minute.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that. Ask an owner or admin.
errors.not-found: We couldn't find that. It may have been removed.
errors.rate-limited: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.conflict: Someone changed this at the same time. Refresh and try again.
errors.unavailable: Trik is briefly unavailable. Try again in a minute.
errors.owner-only: Only an owner can do that.
errors.beyond-own-permissions: You can only give roles within your own permissions.
errors.already-a-member: This person is already on the team. Change their role instead.
errors.last-owner: A workspace needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
errors.cannot-change-own-role: Ask another owner or admin to change your role.
errors.invitation-limit: Too many open invitations. Withdraw some first.
errors.invitation-closed: This invitation was already used or withdrawn.

auth.signInSub: Sign in to your team's inbox and orders.
auth.resetDone: Password changed. Sign in with the new one.
auth.signUpSub: Create your account and your first workspace. It takes a minute.
auth.name: Your name
auth.workspaceHint: Your workspace. You can add more brands later.
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers.
auth.forgotSub: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If {email} has a Trik account, a link to reset the password is on its way. It works for 60 minutes.
auth.resetInvalid: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
auth.panelTitle: Every order confirmed before it ships.
auth.panelBody: Your team's WhatsApp inbox, order confirmation and refusal risk in one place.

errors.failed: That email and password don't match. Try again.
errors.throttled: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

auth.agree: By creating an account, you agree to the {terms} and the {privacy}.

forms.emailTaken: This email already has an account. Sign in instead.

email.title: Confirm your email
email.body: Needed before you can connect a WhatsApp number.

whatsapp.title: Connect your WhatsApp number
whatsapp.body: The number your customers already know.

confirmation.title: Turn on order confirmation
confirmation.body: Choose the message, the reminder and when to call.

store.title: Connect your store
store.body: Shopify and EasyOrders orders arrive by themselves.

settings.sessionsSub: Sign out anywhere you don't recognise.

order.title: Order {n}

next.fix_address: The address needs fixing before confirming

order.cancelBody: The customer won't get it. You can't undo this from the inbox.

inbox.title: Inbox

open.title: No open conversations
open.body: When customers message your WhatsApp number, their chats show here.

mine.title: Nothing assigned to you
mine.body: Conversations you take or are given show here.

unassigned.title: Everything has an owner
unassigned.body: No conversation is waiting for someone to take it.

closed.title: No closed conversations
closed.body: Closed chats show here; a new customer message reopens them.

pick.title: Pick a conversation
pick.body: Choose a chat on the left to read it and reply.

inbox.enterHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
inbox.windowClosed: The customer last wrote more than 24 hours ago, so WhatsApp only allows approved template messages now. Templates come in a later update; the chat reopens as soon as the customer writes again.
inbox.readOnly: You can read this conversation but your role can't reply. Ask an owner or admin.

errors.window-closed: The 24-hour window closed: only template messages can be sent now.
errors.no-number: No WhatsApp number is connected to send from.
errors.cannot-assign: Your role can only take conversations for yourself.
errors.assignee-cannot-view: That person can't see the inbox, so they can't be assigned.
errors.address-needs-fix: Fix the delivery address before confirming this order.
errors.invalid-transition: This order has moved on; refresh to see where it is.
errors.order-changed: Someone changed this order at the same time. Refresh and try again.

new.title: No new orders
new.body: New orders from your store or chat land here first.

awaiting_customer.title: Nobody to wait for
awaiting_customer.body: Orders waiting for the customer to answer the confirmation show here.

needs_call.title: No calls to make
needs_call.body: Orders that got no answer, or need a person, show here.

confirmed.title: No Trik'd orders yet
confirmed.body: Confirmed orders show here, ready to ship.

board.selectAll: Select all orders on this page
board.reasonHint: Kept on the order for your team.

run.title: WhatsApp confirmation
run.none: No confirmation message for this order (confirmation was off, or it was handled by hand).

rules.title: Confirmation rules
rules.sub: Every cash-on-delivery order gets a WhatsApp message with Confirm, Change and Cancel buttons. Choose how it goes.
rules.enabledSub: New COD orders get the confirmation message automatically.
rules.templateHint: Approved templates only. It gets the customer name, the order number and the amount, and three buttons: Confirm, Change, Cancel.
rules.noTemplates: This number has no approved template yet. Create one in WhatsApp Manager, then come back.
rules.escalateHint: Counted from the last message, when no reminders are left.
rules.repliesSub: Sent in the chat when the customer taps a button. Leave empty to send nothing.
rules.change_reply: When they ask for a change
rules.readOnly: You can see the rules, but your role can't change them.

noNumber.title: Connect a WhatsApp number first
noNumber.body: Confirmation messages go out from one of your numbers.

empty.title: No orders yet
empty.body: Orders from your store, chats and calls show here.

errors.owner-cannot-view: That teammate can't see orders, so they can't own this one.
errors.address-incomplete: A delivery address needs the governorate, the area and the street.

orders.fixBanner: The address needs fixing before this order can be confirmed. Edit it below.
orders.rawHint: What the customer or the store wrote, kept for reference.
orders.addressNeeds: The address needs the governorate, the area and the street.

create.title: New order
create.sub: For an order taken on a call or in a chat. It joins the confirmation board like any other.
create.name: Customer name
create.addressLater: You can add the address later; the order will need it before confirming.

stores.title: Connected stores
stores.sub: Orders from your stores arrive in Trik by themselves, and Trik tells the store what happened.

unavailable.title: Store connections are coming
unavailable.body: Connecting Shopify and EasyOrders is being rolled out to sellers in stages.

empty.title: No store connected yet
empty.body: Connect your store and its orders arrive here to be confirmed on WhatsApp.

stores.uninstalledHint: Trik's app was removed from this store, so orders stopped arriving. Connect it again to resume.

backfill.doneSkipped: {n} orders imported since {since}; {skipped} without a phone number skipped
backfill.unsupported: EasyOrders can’t share past orders; new orders arrive from now on.

tag_orders.label: Tag confirmed and cancelled orders
tag_orders.hint: Adds trik-confirmed or trik-cancelled to the order in Shopify.

write_address.label: Send fixed addresses
write_address.hint: Replaces the order's shipping address, keeping the customer's name and phone.

cancel_in_store.label: Cancel in Shopify too
cancel_in_store.hint: Cancels the order there and puts the items back in stock. No refund, no email to the customer.

write_status.label: Update the order status
write_status.hint: Sets the order to confirmed or canceled in EasyOrders.

write_address.label: Add fixed addresses as a note
write_address.hint: EasyOrders can't edit addresses, so Trik adds a private note.

stores.disconnectBody: New orders stop arriving and Trik stops updating the store. Orders already in Trik stay. You can remove Trik's app from the store's admin too.
stores.shopifyHint: Shopify asks you to approve Trik, then your last 90 days of orders are imported.
stores.shopInvalid: Enter your myshopify.com address, e.g. laila.myshopify.com.
stores.easyordersHint: EasyOrders asks you to approve Trik, then new orders arrive as they are placed.
stores.readOnly: You can see the stores, but your role can't connect or change them.

connected.shopify: Shopify connected. Your recent orders are being imported.
connected.easyorders: EasyOrders connected. New orders will arrive as they are placed.

errors.invalid-signature: Shopify's answer couldn't be verified. Try connecting again.
errors.invalid-shop: That isn't a Shopify store address.
errors.expired: The connection took too long. Try again.
errors.shop-mismatch: Shopify answered for another store. Try again.
errors.store-connected-elsewhere: This store is connected to another Trik workspace. Disconnect it there first.
errors.denied: The store wasn't connected: the approval was cancelled.
errors.shopify-error: Shopify didn't finish the connection. Try again in a minute.
errors.shopify-not-configured: Shopify isn't set up on this server yet.
errors.backfill-running: The orders are already being imported.
errors.backfill-unsupported: This store can't share past orders.

risk.title: Refusal risk
risk.sub: Every cash-on-delivery order gets a score from 0 to 100 for how likely it is to be refused, from your own orders only. Each rule adds or takes points; you can change them.

unavailable.title: Refusal risk is coming
unavailable.body: Risk scores are being rolled out to sellers in stages.

risk.thresholdHint: Orders scoring this or more are flagged on the board and their timeline.
risk.rulesHint: Points each rule adds (or takes away). Between −50 and 50.
risk.saved: Saved. Open orders are being scored again.
risk.readOnly: You can see the rules, but your role can't change them.

first_order.label: First order
first_order.hint: The customer hasn't ordered from you before.

refused_before.label: Refused before
refused_before.hint: Per earlier order refused at the door (two counted).

unreachable_before.label: Didn't answer before
unreachable_before.hint: Per earlier order where they never answered the confirmation (two counted).

delivered_before.label: Received before
delivered_before.hint: Per earlier delivered order (three counted). Negative lowers the risk.

high_value.label: Large order
high_value.hint: Twice your usual order amount or more (half the points at 1.5×).

address_incomplete.label: Incomplete address
address_incomplete.hint: No governorate or street to deliver to.

address_flagged.label: Address flagged
address_flagged.hint: An agent flagged the address to fix.

privacy.title: Privacy requests
privacy.sub: Requests from your store platforms to share or erase a customer's data. Trik handles them by itself; data requests need you to send the file to the store owner or customer.

empty.title: No privacy requests
empty.body: When Shopify sends a data or erasure request, it shows here.

results.title: Results
results.sub: Before and after Trik, from your cash-on-delivery orders' own statuses.
results.notLive: Results start with your first WhatsApp confirmation, or the date you set.
results.saved: Saved. The results use the new dates.

empty.title: No results yet
empty.body: Once Trik confirms orders for you, this page compares them with the orders from before.

results.noRecent: No orders in the last days.
results.note: Numbers follow the statuses your store reports. Delivered and refused orders show up as your courier updates the store; recent orders are still on their way.
results.cardSub: Compared with your orders before Trik.

team.title: Team
team.sub: Who works in this workspace, and what each person can do.
team.invitationsSub: Sent, not used yet. A link works once, for 7 days.
team.roleHint: Agents confirm orders and answer chats. Admins also manage the team and settings.
team.linkHint: You can also send them this link yourself, e.g. on WhatsApp. It only works for that email address.
team.removeBody: They lose access to this workspace straight away. You can invite them again later.

invite.title: Team invitation
invite.otherAccount: This invitation is for {invited}, and you're signed in as {current}. Sign in with the invited address to join.

closed.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.
closed.revoked: This invitation was withdrawn. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.

invite.notFoundBody: Check that you opened the whole link, or ask for a new invitation.
invite.signUpSub: Create your account to join the workspace you were invited to.
invite.emailHint: The address the invitation was sent to.

errors.invitation-revoked: This invitation is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
errors.invitation-expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.invitation-other-email: This invitation was sent to another email address.
errors.invitation-not-found: This link doesn't work. Ask for a new invitation.
errors.invitation-invalid: This invitation isn't for this email address, or it has expired.
